verdict.rationale: The 1099 half is documented directly: QuickBooks Payroll creates and e-files 1099-MISC/NEC forms and automatically sends copies to contractors. For W-2s, the docs only say employees can access them online, which implies they are generated and distributed through a portal, but automatic year-end W-2 generation and filing is never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic W-2 generation, filing and distribution at year-end, and independent or hands-on corroboration of either form workflow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end

citations.quote: Create and e-file unlimited 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC form with the IRS** We’ll automatically send copies to your contractors.
Your team can access their pay stubs and W-2s and enter their personal, direct deposit, and tax info online or in app.
We’ll calculate, file, and pay your federal and state payroll taxes for you
